$comment: TypeScript 6 baseline: type-check only (noEmit), bundler/runner-consumed ESM. `module: preserve` derives per-file format from package.json `type` and never models CJS interop transforms the bundler does not perform; `verbatimModuleSyntax` makes import elision explicit. Options that TypeScript 6 already defaults to (strict, esModuleInterop, forceConsistentCasingInFileNames, useDefineForClassFields for ES2022+, allowJs, noUncheckedSideEffectImports) are deliberately not repeated. `lib` and `jsx` belong to the environment presets: this file stays environment-neutral.
